q2_verifier.reason: CONFIRMED VULNERABILITY: Stack-buffer-overflow in dissect_interface_identification_object. Fixed 128-byte buffer (line 902) with user-controlled copy size from network packet (line 909: obj_length = tvb_get_ntohs). Unsafe tvb_memcpy at line 927 copies obj_length-4 bytes without bounds check. Only validates tvb_reported_length_remaining >= 5 (lines 915-918), insufficient to prevent overflow. Attack
